2609.04909.title: Better Understanding, Better Fixes? A Study of Hallucination in LLM-based Automated Program Repair
2609.04909.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced automated program repair (APR), yet existing evaluations remain largely result-centric and provide limited insight into hallucination during repair. In APR, hallucination may arise not only in final patches but also in the intermediate artifacts that guide patch generation. To address this gap, we perform a multi-layered analysis of hallucination throughout the APR process. Specifically, we characterize hallucination as the production of patches or intermediate artifacts that are not faithfully grounded in the available repair evidence. We examine repair hallucination in final patches and understanding hallucination in intermediate artifacts through three tasks, namely triggering testcase identification, line coverage prediction, and additional testcase generation.We then evaluate three representative LLMs on 832 Defects4J bugs through automatic evaluation and manual analysis. Our results show that both repair and understanding hallucinations remain prevalent. Across models and settings, only 21.0%-55.9% of generated patches pass the developer-written test suite. Moreover, although more accurate intermediate artifacts are generally associated with successful repairs, this relationship does not always hold. Manual analysis of 812 sampled repairs identifies repair hallucinations in 72.7% of cases, including patches that pass all available tests; incorrect causal localization and incorrect repair strategies account for 45.9% and 18.5% of these hallucinations, respectively. Meanwhile, models frequently misidentify triggering testcases, mispredict line coverage involving branching control flow, and generate additional testcases with missing bug-triggering conditions or incorrect expected behavior.
2609.04909.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在自動程式修復（APR）方面有了顯著的進展，但現有的評估仍然主要以結果為中心，對於修復過程中的幻覺提供的見解有限。在APR中，幻覺不僅可能出現在最終的修補程式中，還可能出現在指導修補生成的中間產物中。為了解決這一空白，我們對APR過程中的幻覺進行了多層次的分析。具體來說，我們將幻覺定義為生成的修補程式或中間產物未能忠實地基於可用的修復證據。我們通過三個任務來檢查最終修補程式中的修復幻覺以及中間產物中的幻覺理解，即觸發測試用例識別、行覆蓋預測和額外測試用例生成。然後，我們通過自動評估和手動分析對832個Defects4J錯誤評估三個代表性的LLMs。我們的結果顯示，修復和理解幻覺仍然普遍存在。在不同的模型和設置中，只有21.0%-55.9%的生成修補程式通過開發者編寫的測試套件。此外，雖然更準確的中間產物通常與成功的修復相關，但這一關係並不總是成立。對812個抽樣修復的手動分析顯示，72.7%的案例中存在修復幻覺，包括通過所有可用測試的修補程式；不正確的因果定位和不正確的修復策略分別佔這些幻覺的45.9%和18.5%。同時，模型經常錯誤識別觸發測試用例，錯誤預測涉及分支控制流的行覆蓋，並生成缺少錯誤觸發條件或不正確預期行為的額外測試用例。
